Description: MVDR beamforming shall collapse N-element array data to single-channel output by inverting the spatial covariance matrix
Steering vector shall compute plane-wave phase pattern a(theta) = exp(j*2*pi*x*sin(theta)/lambda) for arbitrary linear array
Sample spatial covariance shall be computed as R = (1/K) * rx.^T * conj(rx) matching the standard E[x*x^H] convention
Diagonal loading shall regularise the covariance inverse under snapshot-deficient conditions
Matched-filter pulse compression shall be applied per pulse using full-length convolution with time-reversed conjugate of transmit chirp
Matched filter output indexing shall map sample i to delay (i-1) samples with no post-hoc range-axis offset
Hamming window shall be applied across slow-time before Doppler FFT to suppress Doppler sidelobes
Doppler FFT shall be computed across pulses per range cell
fftshift shall place zero-Doppler bin at the centre of the velocity axis
Range axis shall map to physical distance via i*c/(2*fs) metres per sample
Velocity axis shall map to physical velocity via v = lambda*f_d/2 with positive = closing
CA-CFAR detector shall estimate local noise from a training ring around a guard region and threshold above alpha*noise
CFAR threshold multiplier shall follow the Rohling formula alpha = N_train*(Pfa^(-1/N_train) - 1) for exponential noise
Guard cells around each cell under test shall be excluded from the noise estimate
CFAR detections shall be extracted as a top-K list sorted by power (K = 16) with SNR estimated from a global noise floor
Root inport rx_cube shall accept a Nspp_receive x 8 x 16 complex IQ data cube
Root inport look_angle_rad shall accept the steering direction in radians from array broadside
Root inport tx shall accept the transmit reference chirp for matched filtering
Root outport det_range_m shall expose detection range in metres for up to 16 top hits
Root outport n_detections shall expose the actual detection count as int32
